name: No-Sugar-Added Duo Chocolate Slice
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder · Triton's / Disney Magic · Lumiere's
whyItWorks: Smooth dark and white chocolate mousse layers over thin sponge with zero seeds or citrus.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Eat half a slice to avoid osmotic bloating from sugar-free polyols (maltitol/sorbitol) and take a Lactaid.
watchOuts: Sugar alcohols (maltitol/sorbitol) can draw water into the bowel
